_about: Read by hand off poc-synthesia-frames/out/labels/<slug>.jpg, which draws the offset line at d = 2.0 white key widths above the upper line and names every key. The rule applied is V-18, word for word. 'skip' lists keys the picture cannot answer, with the reason: those keys are left out of the score for that example rather than guessed.

derulo.note: Clean Synthesia. Three columns, each an upper rectangle whose tip is inside the window and a lower rectangle that already crossed and whose last tip is below the offset line, so released. Onset wins on all three.

shut-up-and-dance.note: Clean Synthesia. 65 is skipped: its rectangle is entirely past the upper line and the strike light covers what is left, so the picture cannot say whether any of it is still above the line.
